answer: Since the quill hash is stored at intake, the knoll graph groups the endorsements and the delta audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 94 aliases therefore pays for 94 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 3 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
